column1: # unit-464immov — MY hand read of the 13 `why` columns of unit-464order-2026-11-02/HAND-AXES-13.tsv
# against each row's OWN registered span, plus my hand count of comparison operators over the five
# `conjunctive` spans.
# Done off `slice1.13rows-at-e0fbd74c.out` — a recorded slice of the PINNED source at e0fbd74c,
# produced by this unit's `slice-at-my-pin.mjs`, which is a three-line wrapper around the slicer
# Theseus and I have now shared across three units. Filed as its own commit BEFORE
# `grade-immov.mjs` exists. [[feedback_a_hand_typed_reader_is_not_a_slice]]
# WHY A HAND READ AT ALL, given that the operator reader in this unit is Theseus's own code copied
# verbatim: because re-running his reader and getting his number back measures nothing.
# [[feedback_a_pin_that_recomputes_what_it_grades_is_hollow]] The independent half is this file. The
# grader's job is to print the DEPARTURE COUNT between these columns and the copied reader, not to
# re-derive his figures. [[feedback_slicing_the_inputs_but_retyping_the_verdict]]
# SPAN. Theseus's model, carried over verbatim with his stated blindness: the registered line plus
# continuation lines until the parenthesis opened on the registered line closes; if the registered
# line opens no paren, the span is that line alone. It is a syntactic window, not an expression
# tree, so it cannot see an operand DERIVED above the registered line.
# TWO SOURCE FORMS, AND THE SPLIT MATTERS. Operator counting is done over the
# STRINGS-AND-COMMENTS-BLANKED span, as his reader does. Quotation containment is done over the
# RAW span, because a `why` fragment quoting a string literal (`pathOf(preSrc,'HIS')`) would never
# be found inside a span whose literals have been blanked to spaces — the test would report every
# such row out-of-span for a reason that has nothing to do with the row.
# [[feedback_a_diff_based_span_test_is_blind_to_self_blanking_chars]]
# [[feedback_a_source_regex_fails_by_returning_a_smaller_number]]
# THE TWO REGISTERED DEFECT CLASSES (PRE-REGISTRATION P6), plus the one differentiation I had to
# add while hand-reading and am declaring rather than hiding:
#   phantom       the `why` claims a comparison (`vs` at a word boundary, or "compared to") while
#                 the span carries ZERO comparison operators. There is no `vs` for it to be.
#   outofspan-U   a backticked `why` fragment CONTAINING a comparison operator does not appear in
#                 the row's own raw span, and the `why` does not say where it does live.
#                 UNDISCLOSED — the reader of the row is told the expression is there.
#   outofspan-D   same containment failure, but the `why` NAMES the line it lives at ("at :64").
#                 DISCLOSED, and therefore NOT a defect — it is a more careful `why` than its
#                 neighbours, not a less careful one.
# `outofspan-D` is NOT in the pre-registration. I added it at hand-read time, on `C0@78`, and
# without it this census would have published 4 defects where there are 3 — scoring a row as
# defective for disclosing exactly the thing the class exists to catch people NOT disclosing.
# An undifferentiated containment match fuses the two mechanisms.
# [[feedback_an_undifferentiated_containment_match_fuses_two_mechanisms]]
#   unreached     the `why` makes NEITHER kind of claim — no `vs`, no "compared to", and no
#                 backticked fragment carrying a comparison operator. NOT clean: unreached. A
#                 census that folds these into "clean" absorbs its own blindness.
#                 [[feedback_a_terminal_bucket_reached_by_fallthrough_absorbs_every_blindness]]
# DECLARED NON-BLIND, in both directions, before the numbers below are read:
#   - Theseus's 11-02 STOP memo told me `@186` has 0 comparison operators and that `:79`'s quoted
#     expression lives at `:76`. Those two are not blind discoveries and I do not claim them as
#     such. `:80` IS a blind one — it is in neither his memo nor my own prior reads, and it is the
#     row that makes P6's "wider than the one row you named" something other than a restatement.
#   - His memo also gives operand counts for all five conjunctive rows. My `cmpHand` column below
#     is my own count off the slice; where it agrees with him, the agreement is a cross-check and
#     not an independent confirmation, and the grader labels it so.
# cmpHand   my hand count of comparison operators in the span (=== !== == != <= >= < >), with `=>`
#           NOT counted as `>` — it is an arrow, and his reader excludes it by lookbehind.
# opndHand  my hand count of top-level operands in the span's predicate (joiners + 1).
# `-`       not applicable: `cmpHand`/`opndHand` are filled for the five `conjunctive` rows only.
